title: Ssense DPDP Compliance Audit Result
description: Deterministic legal audit output bridging the SLM reasoning engine to the Rust network interceptor.

global_legal_reasoning.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning analyzing the affirmative policy text against the DPDP Act and 2025 Rules before any conclusions are made. Must not contain omission complaints.

violations.description: Specific statutory violations detected, coupled directly with their mechanical enforcement actions.

step_1_active_claim_analysis.description: Analyze the active, affirmative words in the quote to ensure they are NOT based on silence or omission.

step_2_statute_match.description: Explain how the extracted quote explicitly matches the targeted statute. Ensure there is no statute stretching or mismatch.

omission_check.description: CRITICAL FIREWALL: Must evaluate if the violation relies on what the policy fails to state. If based on silence, this MUST evaluate to true (which will trigger a pipeline drop). If based on an active, printed claim, evaluate to false.

step_3_semantic_justification.description: Explain exactly why the affirmative text extracted in step_1 constitutes a violation without using banned omission phrases.

statute_reference.description: The exact Section or Rule violated (e.g., 'Section 4', 'Rule 8(3)', 'Rule 13(4)').

evidence_quote.description: The exact verbatim string extracted from the policy. Must be at least 20 characters and contain no internal periods to prevent truncation bugs.

offending_entities.description: Specific targets for the network action. Empty array if none exist.

dpdp_trust_score.description: A score from 0 to 100 indicating the overall compliance health of the policy (0 being highly non-compliant).

subtlety_score.description: A score from 0 to 100 indicating how subtly the violation is camouflaged within corporate jargon (100 being masterfully hidden).
